points.point: 每條規格主張必須標明型號與來源文件版次，來源未標版次就要明說沒標
points.label: partial
points.why: cites some R&S model/source versions, but not as a rule for every claim or unversioned sources

points.point: 規格數字必須連同測試條件一起引用，不換算單位；option 相依性照抄原文，不自行推論相容性
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions options and measurement scenario, but not test conditions, no unit conversion, or no inferred option compatibility

points.point: 只有 specifications with limits / without limits 代表保證效能；typ./nom./meas./n. trc. 不由 R&S 保證，不能用來做比較主張
points.label: partial
points.why: says distinguish warranted from non-binding data, but omits typ./nom./meas./n. trc. and comparison prohibition

points.point: 訊號分析儀規格文件同樣註明無 tolerance limits 的資料不具約束力且可能變更
points.label: partial
points.why: states FSW data without tolerance limits is not binding, but not that it may change

points.point: 對競品的主張若只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源，用於客戶文件前必須另查對手官方資料與第三方證據
points.label: partial
points.why: says internal battle-card narratives need official verification, but omits third-party evidence and customer-document condition

points.point: only platform、first validated、leadership、lower TCO 等銷售語言不可當作可驗證技術規格
points.label: missing
points.why: does not address sales language such as only platform or leadership

points.point: 現有 battle card 未提供競品的正式 datasheet、文件版次、order number、option code、release status 或測試條件
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions missing/needed option-code verification, but not the full list of absent competitor evidence

points.point: Aerospace / Defense（衛星、UAV）的 R&S solution mapping 只是 sales mapping，不可當作測試配置建議書，仍需 sales kits、application notes、datasheet 或正式 proposal
points.label: partial
points.why: says mappings/recommendations are not enough for formal configuration, but omits sales mapping warning and required sales kits/app notes/proposal

invented: MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, and RTCA DO-160 as common EMC-related standards
Starlink UT test-flow source maps spectrum analyzer equipment to R&S FSW and Keysight N9040B UXA, and signal generator equipment to R&S SMW200A and Keysight E8257D PSG
